summary: Cartesian Growth Corp II filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to postpone its extraordinary general meeting from July 27 to July 30, 2026. The meeting seeks shareholder approval to extend the deadline for a business combination from August 5, 2026 to August 5, 2027. The redemption deadline is also extended to July 28, 2026. No special-situation event is announced; this is a routine procedural postponement by a blank-check company.
